video_script.title: Building to the Wrong Number
video_script.hook: Two independent studies find errors in the sea level data underlying the Army Corps' $34 billion Galveston coastal protection system.
body_slides: Thirty-four billion dollars riding on a century-old gauge.
Two studies found the same flaw in opposite directions.
The sea rises while the ground sinks beneath.
video_script.voiceover_text: That tide gauge at Galveston has been measuring sea level since 1904. The Army Corps just spent 34 billion on flood barriers based on those measurements. Two new studies say the math is wrong. Thirty-four billion dollars riding on a century-old gauge. Two studies found the same flaw in opposite directions. The sea rises while the ground sinks beneath. We built the wrong wall. Follow for more stories like this at The Docket.
